_comment: DRISHTI Catalyst Cache segments (Phase 14 Part B / matrix row 9). Cache holds ONLY bounded-TTL, reconstructable state - never a system of record. Created in Console -> Cache (no CLI). Enabled via DRISHTI_USE_CATALYST_CACHE. TTLs mirror app/cache.py DEFAULT_TTL_S.

segments.name: idempotency
segments.purpose: Dedupe prediction/import/report/notify requests by idempotency key.
segments.notes: add_if_absent(key) -> False means duplicate; prevents double-dispatch.

segments.name: ratelimit
segments.purpose: Per-IP / per-role sliding-window counters in front of the gateway facade.
segments.notes: Complements API Gateway throttling; incr() per request window.

segments.name: nonce
segments.purpose: Signed-context nonce replay guard across AppSail instances (app/gateway_context.py).
segments.notes: Cross-instance replay protection; the in-process cache is the local fallback.

segments.name: lookup
segments.notes: Always reconstructable from Data Store; safe to evict.
